# enauto-v2

Cisco 300-435 ENAUTO v2.0 study repository.

**Owner:** Alberto Ássimos ([@betoAssimos](https://github.com/betoAssimos))
**Target date:** 2026-08-17
**Status:** Week 10 / 13 — Foundation

## Structure

```
enauto-v2/
├── master_context.md          # rules and reference
├── handover.md                # current position
├── labs/                      # lab code, one folder per blueprint domain
│   ├── 01-foundation/
│   ├── 02-device/
│   ├── 03-catalyst-center/
│   ├── 03-meraki/
│   ├── 03-sdwan/
│   ├── 03-ise/
│   ├── 04-operations/
│   └── 05-ai/
├── tests/                     # tests where they add value (e.g., MCP server in Week 11)
├── secrets.example.env        # env var names, no values
├── requirements.txt
├── pyproject.toml
└── .gitignore
```

## Quickstart

```bash
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp secrets.example.env .env   # then fill in sandbox credentials
```
